final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), step2 AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS distinct_films FROM film_actor), step3 AS (SELECT s1.actor_id, s1.film_count, CAST(s1.film_count AS REAL) / s2.distinct_films AS ratio FROM step1 s1, step2 s2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3) SELECT s3.actor_id, s3.film_count, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS deviation FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 ORDER BY deviation DESC LIMIT 10
